headline: Kross Limited declares voting results of postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot results finalized by Kross
summary: Kross Limited has submitted the exchange outcome and voting results of its postal ballot conducted via remote e-voting. The filing complies with Regulations 30 and 44(3) of SEBI LODR requirements. This is routine corporate governance filing with no immediate financial impact on retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no direct impact on stock price
